verdict.rationale: Autumn ships an official MCP server that exposes billing, customer, plan, balance, and log tools to AI assistants, enabling natural-language operation of the platform rather than only code/CLI usage. This is first-party documented and specifically framed as connecting AI assistants to Autumn's functions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the MCP server being used successfully in practice, and more detail on the breadth of natural-language commands it supports.
